actions.name: update_ticket
actions.title: Update ticket
actions.help: Update ticket standard or custom fields, or add a comment to a ticket. Ticket to edit is identified by its Zendesk ID.

input.name: id
input.label: Ticket ID
input.hint: Zendesk internal ID of ticket to update

input.name: comment
input.label: Text comment
input.hint: Adds a simple text comment to the ticket. Note: Atleast one of the comments is required to create ticket ( Text comment/ Voice comment/HTML comment )

input.name: comment_public
input.label: Comment public
input.hint: Select yes to make it a public comment

input.name: comment_author_id
input.label: Comment author ID
input.hint: User ID of the author of the comment

input.name: upload_tokens
input.label: Upload attachment token
input.hint: Get token from Upload attachment action. To upload multiple attachments provide comma-separated token values.

input.name: subject
input.label: Subject
input.hint: Ticket topic or subject.

input.name: type
input.label: Type
input.hint: The type of support ticket to update. Allowed values are 'problem', 'incident', 'question', 'task'

input.name: priority
input.label: Priority
input.hint: Ticket priority

input.name: external_id
input.label: External ID
input.hint: ID to link this ticket to external records.

input.name: status
input.label: Status
input.hint: Ticket status

input.name: requester_id
input.label: Requester ID
input.hint: Defaults to user who requested the ticket if left empty.

input.name: brand_id
input.label: Brand ID
input.hint: The ID of the brand to be associated with the ticket. This feature is available only for Zendesk enterprise subscription.

input.name: submitter_id
input.label: Submitter ID
input.hint: Defaults to user who submitted the ticket if left empty

input.name: organization_id
input.label: Organization ID
input.hint: Defaults to the organization requester belongs to if left empty

input.name: group_id
input.label: Group ID
input.hint: Defaults to the group the ticket is assigned to if left empty.

input.name: forum_topic_id
input.label: Forum topic ID
input.hint: Forum topic that ticket originated from, if any.

input.name: recipient
input.label: Recipient email address
input.hint: Email address that received the ticket, if any.

input.name: has_incidents
input.label: Has incidents
input.hint: Yes if ticket is marked as a problem, No if not. Defaults to No if left empty.

input.name: due_at
input.label: Due at
input.hint: Tickets of type Task will have a due date.

input.name: tags_string
input.label: Tags
input.hint: Comma separated list of tags. For eg. enterprise, important.
